_comment: Milestone savestates for the play harness. .sav files are gitignored (binary, machine-specific); this manifest is committed so the set is documented and reproducible. Load with: python ctl.py launch --load-state <name>  (or load-state <name> on a running session).

states.name: main_menu_fresh
states.desc: Title -> Start -> created a fresh save -> main menu (Story/Battle Mode). Cursor on CONTINUE.

states.name: name_entry
states.desc: New Game confirmed -> 'Your name?' screen with Wes model and NEW NAME/WES/SETH/THOMAS list.

states.name: intro_start
states.desc: Name confirmed (WES) -> opening desert/Snagem-hideout cutscene begins.
